caption: The drawing depicts the upper portion of a human head wearing a large, ruffled bonnet that covers the hair and part of the forehead. The bonnet is characterized by wide, undulating ruffles, with a scalloped edge highlighted along the rim and around the face area. The bonnet is rendered in a pale beige or off-white color, with subtle shading to indicate the folds and depth of the fabric. The face is shown without detailed features, only the outline of the face and suggestions of eyebrows and lips are indicated with light pencil. In the lower right of the drawing, there is a smaller secondary sketch of the bonnet viewed from the back, showing the gathered and ruffled structure. The background is plain, uncolored paper, and the drawing is executed in a combination of pencil outlines and light washes of color, with the majority of the detail focused on the texture and shape of the bonnet.
title: Headdress
